claims.object_text: rat middle cerebral artery occlusion (MCAO) model: GRIA3 protein expression significantly downregulated in model vs sham
claims.quote: the expression levels of key proteins -- CaMKII, calmodulin, CX36, PKC, CX43, GRIA3, GABRA6, and NPY1R were significantly downregulated in the model group, while the expression of CaN was significantly upregulated (P < 0.05).
